security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Veld Manager — workspaces, folders, repos, accounts, tenant scopes
bundle.longDescription: Veld Manager is the desktop console that unifies GitHub accounts, repositories, worktrees, workspaces, and per-project Veld tenant scopes, and brokers per-project keys for the Veld memory system.
